# Adjudication Task — Chapter 359

## Korean source

```text
  1|＃359화
  2|
  3|
  4|
  5|투두둑.
  6|
  7|몸에 붙은 돌 부스러기를 털어 낸 서천마군이 고개를 좌우로 꺾었다. 뼈 어긋나는 소리와 함께 미간이 찡그려진다.
  8|
  9|“자네, 주먹이 맵구먼. 호신강기(護身罡氣)가 없었다면 정말 크게 다쳤을 수도 있겠어.”
 10|
 11|맵기는 개뿔이.
 12|
 13|나는 전력을 다한 화염신장과 멸염신권을 처맞고도 멀쩡히 일어서는 서천마군을 보며 한숨을 푹 내쉬었다.
 14|
 15|“호신강기는 그렇다 치고. 너 같은 놈이 템까지 끼는 건 반칙 아니냐?”
 16|
 17|“뎀? 그게 뭔가?”
 18|
 19|나는 서천마군의 찢어진 황색 장삼 사이로 보이는 검은색 비늘 갑옷을 가리켰다.
 20|
 21|“네가 지금 안에 입고 있는 그거. 이 자식아.”
 22|
 23|“아, 흑룡갑(黑龍鉀)을 말하는 거였군.”
 24|
 25|“흑룡갑?”
 26|
 27|이름 간지 나는 것 보소.
 28|
 29|흑룡갑이 정확히 뭔지는 몰라도 방어구로서의 성능은 신병이기라고 불러도 부족함이 없을 것 같다.
 30|
 31|전력을 다한 공격을 두 번이나 막아 내고도 비늘이 조금 떨어진 게 고작이니까.
 32|
 33|‘저 정도 방어력이면 권, 장으로는 무리야.’
 34|
 35|암천의 일반 무인들이 착용하고 있던 피갑도 상당했지만, 흑룡갑에 비할 바는 아니다.
 36|
 37|‘이에는 이. 눈에는 눈. 신병이기에는 신병이기.’
 38|
 39|흑룡갑의 존재가 있는 한, 적어도 놈에게 치명적인 상처를 입히기 위해서는 백염(白炎)이 필수다.
 40|
 41|‘그것도 아니라면…….’
 42|
 43|탐색하듯 바라보는 내 시선에 서천마군이 빙긋 웃었다.
 44|
 45|“자네는 보면 볼수록 참 재미있는 젊은이야. 괴이한 술법도 그렇지만, 물러서지 않는 투지가 마음에 들어.”
 46|
 47|“그래서. 사귈래?”
 48|
 49|“정중하게 거절하겠네. 이미 오랫동안 사귄 정인(情人)이 있거든.”
 50|
 51|서천마군이 구불구불한 검신을 부드럽게 쓸었다. 반으로 뚝 부러진 검의 절단면에서 묵빛 검강이 솟아오른다.
 52|
 53|“자네 밑천은 모두 보았으니, 이제 내 차례로군.”
 54|
 55|서천마군이 나직한 중얼거림과 함께 걸음을 내디딘다. 숨 막히는 기세가 그의 등 뒤로 날개처럼 일렁였다.
 56|
 57|나는 그제야 깨달았다. 서천마군의 무공이 내가 생각했던 것보다 훨씬 아득한 경지에 도달해 있다는 것을.
 58|
 59|“……제기랄.”
 60|
 61|데엥.
 62|
 63|어딘가 2라운드의 시작을 알리는 종소리가 울려 퍼지는 듯했다.
 64|
 65|하지만 이건 12라운드까지 치르면 끝나는 복싱 경기가 아니다. 환호와 탄식을 내지르는 관객도, 수건을 던져 줄 스태프도 없다.
 66|
 67|목숨, 오로지 목숨을 던져야 끝나는 경기다.
 68|
 69|‘인벤토리 오픈. 소환.’
 70|
 71|차가운 창대가 손아귀에 잡힌다. 크게 숨을 들이마신 나는 서천마군을 향해 창날을 겨누었다.
 72|
 73|“들어와.”
 74|
 75|서천마군은 사양하지 않았다.
 76|
 77|
 78|
 79|* * *
 80|
 81|
 82|
 83|파팟!
 84|
 85|서천마군이 발을 뻗었다.
 86|
 87|이형환위(移形換位). 사라진 신형이 다시 나타난 곳은 내 머리 위 허공이었다.
 88|
 89|나는 솜털이 쭈뼛서는 감각과 함께 몸을 뒤로 젖혔다.
 90|
 91|사아아악! 꽝!
 92|
 93|손톱만큼의 차이로 콧날을 스친 놈의 발뒤꿈치가 바닥을 찍었다. 지면이 움푹 꺼지고 돌 조각이 사방으로 비산한다.
 94|
 95|풍압(風壓)에 베인 콧날에서 핏물이 흘렀지만 닦아 낼 여유조차 주어지지 않았다.
 96|
 97|쉬쉬쉬쉭!
 98|
 99|묵빛 검기가 사방에서 빗발쳤다. 허리, 가슴, 배, 가리지 않고 긋고 베고 휘둘러진다.
100|
101|과거였다면 결코 피하지 못했을 공격들. 하지만 이제는 아니었다.
102|
103|‘보인다.’
104|
105|느려진 세상 속, 나를 향해 쏘아지는 검기를 느꼈다.
106|
107|저 파괴적인 기운이 어디로 움직일지, 피하기 위해서는 어떻게 움직여야 할지 머릿속에 그려진다.
108|
109|몸은 생각보다 앞서 이미 움직이고 있었다.
110|
111|콰과과과광!
112|
113|더러는 피하고, 더러는 창을 휘둘러 튕겨 냈다. 자욱하게 솟은 먼지구름과 전쟁 영화에서나 보던 크레이터가 사방에 가득했다.
114|
115|그리고…….
116|
117|후우웅!
118|
119|칙칙한 빛을 뿌리는 묵빛 검강이 먼지구름을 가르며 튀어나왔다. 가라앉은 눈빛을 한 서천마군이 비스듬한 사선으로 검을 내리긋는다.
120|
121|무슨 무공인지, 어떤 초식인지 알 길이 없다.
122|
123|다만 한 가지. 여기서 물러난다면 내게 남은 것은 죽음밖에 없을 거라는 생각이 머릿속을 가득 채웠다.
124|
125|‘받아쳐야 한다.’
126|
127|검강에 맞설 만큼 강한 힘. 내가 가진 최선의 한 수가 필요한 시점이다.
128|
129|답은 처음부터 나와 있는 것이나 다름없었다.
130|
131|‘일섬(一殲).’
132|
133|꾸구국.
134|
135|전신의 근육이 활시위처럼 당겨졌다. 발이 먼저 나가고 한껏 젖혀진 허리가 앞으로 향한다. 어깨와 팔을 타고 흘러간 회전력이 창날에 더해졌다.
136|
137|콰아아아!
138|
139|창기라고 부르기에는 너무나도 거대한 기의 집약체.
140|
141|푸른 화염을 머금은 창날이 나아간다. 공기를 태우고 먼지구름을 살라 먹으며 한 사람을 향해 쏘아졌다.
142|
143|“……!”
144|
145|서천마군의 눈이 크게 뜨였다. 동시에 검신이 부르르 떨리며 더욱 거대한 검강이 솟구쳤다.
146|
147|다음 순간, 푸른 화염과 검은 어둠이 격돌했다.
148|
149|꽈아아앙-!
150|
151|그러자 지금껏 들어 본 적 없는 굉음과 함께 반경 십여 장의 모든 것이 부서지고 터져 나갔다.
152|
153|충격을 견디지 못한 천장의 일부가 무너져 내리고, 단단하기 그지없는 암석은 가루가 되어 흩날렸다.
154|
155|그 사이에, 우뚝 서 있는 한 사람이 있었다.
156|
157|“빌어먹을.”
158|
159|전력을 다한 일섬마저도 먹히지 않는다니.
160|
161|허탈해하는 내 모습에 서천마군이 고개를 내저었다. 그의 어깨에서는 핏물이 흘러내리고 있었다. 그것이 일섬이 남긴 전부였다.
162|
163|“실망할 것 없네. 충분히 위력적인 초식이었으니까. 순간 가슴이 서늘해질 정도로 말일세.”
164|
165|“하나만 묻자.”
166|
167|“뭐든지.”
168|
169|“처음부터 힘을 낭비하지 않고 방금 그 일격을 날렸다면…… 널 죽일 수 있었을까.”
170|
171|곰곰이 생각하던 서천마군이 대답했다.
172|
173|“팔 하나 정도는 가져갈 수 있었을 것 같군. 어쩌면 그 이상도. 하지만 죽는 건 자네였겠지.”
174|
175|“제기랄. 그럴 줄 알았지.”
176|
177|“이제 끝내야 할 시간인 것 같군.”
178|
179|후우우웅.
180|
181|이젠 놀랍지도 않다. 마치 마르지 않는 샘물처럼 솟구친 검강이 채찍처럼 휘둘려졌다.
182|
183|나는 공력의 소모로 인한 극심한 탈력감을 느끼며 이를 악물었다.
184|
185|“아직…… 안 끝났어.”
186|
187|남아 있는 모든 공력을 끌어올려 화룡신창(火龍神槍)을 펼쳤다.
188|
189|앞서와 달리 확연히 크기가 줄어든 푸른 화염이 쏘아진 곳은, 훤히 드러나 있는 서천마군의 목이었다.
190|
191|쐐애애애액!
192|
193|그리고 다음 순간, 서천마군의 흔들림 없는 눈동자를 마주한 나는 깨달았다.
194|
195|‘읽혔다.’
196|
197|깨달음이 뇌리를 관통했을 때는 늦었다. 금방이라도 나를 베어 버릴 것 같던 검강이 허공에서 뚝 꺾이며 창날을 후려쳤다.
198|
199|꽈앙!
200|
201|하늘이 쪼개지는 듯한 굉음이 울려 퍼졌다. 나는 거세게 요동치는 창대를 붙잡으며 이를 악물었다.
202|
203|어느새 지면 깊숙이 발목이 틀어박힌 나를 향해 검강이 휘둘려졌다.
204|
205|쉬쉬쉬쉬쉭!
206|
207|상하좌우. 내 몸을 중심으로 한 서른여섯 개의 방위에서 가공할 기운이 날아든다.
208|
209|전신이 곤두서는 감각과 함께 미친 듯이 창을 휘둘렀다.
210|
211|쾅! 콰과과과광!
212|
213|일격, 일격을 받아칠 때마다 몸이 휘청이고 숨이 막혔다. 이건 속도나 힘의 문제가 아니었다.
214|
215|무공, 그리고 공력.
216|
217|서천마군의 무공은 내가 닿을 수 없는 아득한 곳에 있었고, 창을 타고 전해지는 무시무시한 공력은 내 신체 내부를 진탕 시켰다.
218|
219|‘이런 미친……!’
220|
221|악문 잇새 사이로 핏물이 튄다. 찢어진 손아귀는 이미 피범벅이 된 지 오래.
222|
223|나는 젖먹던 힘까지 쥐어짜, 가슴을 갈라 오는 묵빛 검강을 향해 창을 휘둘렀다.
224|
225|화룡신창 이 초식. 천격.
226|
227|쐐애애액, 꽈앙!
228|
229|그러나 화룡의 발톱은 처음과 달리 형편없이 약해져 있었고, 서천마군의 묵빛 검강은 조금도 힘을 잃지 않았다.
230|
231|콰드드득!
232|
233|지면에 긴 밭고랑을 만들며 물러난 내가 목격한 것은, 지진이 난 것처럼 흔들리는 뇌옥과 주위에 자욱한 먼지구름이었다.
234|
235|‘없다.’
236|
237|앞에도, 좌우와 허공에도 서천마군이 보이지 않는다.
238|
239|그렇다면 남은 답은 하나뿐이다. 나는 돌아서며 일장을 날렸다.
240|
241|팡! 퍼벙!
242|
243|동시에 울려 퍼진 두 개의 소리.
244|
245|화염신장(火焰神掌)의 열기는 공기를 태웠고, 서천마군의 일장은 내 가슴에 닿아 있었다.
246|
247|시야가 하얗게 물들고, 심맥이 가닥가닥 끊기는 고통이 뒤를 잇는다. 나는 울컥 치미는 핏물을 삼키며 튕겨 나가는 신형을 바로 잡았다.
248|
249|“놀라웠네. 진심이야.
250|
251|“……!”
252|
253|그건 본능이었다.
254|
255|어느새 옆에서 들려오는 나직한 목소리에 저절로 팔이 움직인다. 목덜미를 향해 쏘아지던 수도(手刀)가 팔뚝을 가격했다.
256|
257|우두둑!
258|
259|뼈가 어긋나는 소리와 함께 밀려드는 고통. 이어 채찍처럼 휘둘러진 서천마군의 발끝이 옆구리를 파고들었다.
260|
261|퍽, 콰앙!
262|
263|암석을 부수고 벽면에 틀어박힌 나를 향해 서천마군이 천천히 걸음을 옮겼다.
264|
265|그의 눈빛에 서린 감정은 감탄과 기쁨이었다.
266|
267|“대단하군. 정말이지 대단해. 지금 자네가 뭘 했는지 알고 있나?”
268|
269|나는 피가래를 뱉으며 대답했다.
270|
271|“몰라, 이 씨벌놈아.”
272|
273|“자랑스럽게 생각해도 좋네. 전력을 다한 날 상대로 삼백 초를 넘게 버텼으니까.”
274|
275|“삼백 초라. 그거 눈물 나게 기쁘네.”
276|
277|“별로 기뻐하지 않은 것 같으니 다르게 말해 주지. 경천신니와 그 장로들이 오백여 초를 버텼다면 어떤가?”
278|
279|“아니, 전혀.”
280|
281|“어째서?”
282|
283|진심으로 이해가 가지 않는다는 표정을 한 서천마군을 향해 한 마디를 툭 던졌다.
284|
285|“어차피 죽었으니까.”
286|
287|삼백 초, 오백 초, 천 초를 버틴다고 해도 싸움에서 진다면 결국 패자에게 남는 것은 죽음뿐이다.
288|
289|경천신니나 독왕도 그 범주를 벗어나지 못했다.
290|
291|그리고…… 나 역시도 마찬가지겠지.
292|
293|“쿨럭.”
294|
295|벌어진 입술 사이로 핏물이 흘러나왔다.
296|
297|앞서 서천마군이 했던 것처럼 아무렇지도 않게 일어나고 싶었지만, 그러기에는 몸 상태가 말이 아니다.
298|
299|‘내상은 말할 것도 없고, 왼쪽 팔은 골절, 가슴 쪽도 뼈에 금이 갔나.’
300|
301|정말 된통 당했다. 어쩐지. 아까부터 숨쉬기가 불편하더라니.
302|
303|나는 가쁜 숨을 내쉬며 백염을 지팡이 삼아 몸을 일으켰다.
304|
305|그런 내 모습에 서천마군이 눈동자를 빛냈다.

307|“아직 보여 줄 게 남았나?”

[P68]
Grind.

Kraaaaaash!

“…!”

[P76]
KABOOOOOM!

Amid it all, one man remained standing.

“Damn it.”

[P82]

[P83]
“There’s no need to be disappointed. It was a sufficiently powerful form. For a moment, it even sent a chill through my heart.”

[P84]
“Let me ask you one thing.”

[P85]
“Anything.”

[P86]
“If I hadn’t wasted my strength earlier and had opened with that strike… could I have killed you?”

[P87]
The Western Heaven Demon Lord considered it carefully before answering.

[P88]
“I believe you could have taken one of my arms. Perhaps even more than that. But you would have been the one to die.”

[P89]
“Damn it. I knew it.”

[P90]
“I think it’s time to end this.”

[P91]
Whooooosh.

[P92]

[P93]
I gritted my teeth as the drain on my internal energy left me weak to the point of collapse.

[P94]
“It’s… not over yet.”

[P95]
I drew up every last bit of internal energy I had and unleashed the Fire Dragon Divine Spear.

[P96]
The blue flames were visibly smaller than before. They shot toward the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s exposed throat.

[P97]
Screeeeeech!

[P98]
The next instant, I met his unwavering gaze and realized it.

[P99]
*He read me.*

[P100]

[P101]
Boom!

[P102]

[P103]
My ankles were already buried deep in the ground when the Sword Force swept toward me.

[P104]
Shh-shh-shh-shh-shhk!

[P105]
Above, below, left, and right.

[P106]

[P107]

[P108]
Boom! Kra-kra-kra-kaboom!

[P109]

[P110]
This wasn’t a matter of speed or strength.

[P111]
It was martial arts—and internal energy.

[P112]

[P113]
*This is fucking insane…!*

[P114]

[P115]

[P117]
*Heavenly Strike.*

[P118]
Screeeeeech! Boom!

[P119]

[P120]
Krrrrk!

*He’s gone.*

I spun around and unleashed a palm strike.

[P127]
Bang! Boom!

Two sounds rang out at once.

“…!”

Crack!

[P137]
Thud! Boom!

[P138]

[P139]
Admiration and delight filled his eyes.

[P141]
I spat out a mouthful of bloody phlegm.

[P142]
“No, you fucking bastard.”

[P143]
“You should be proud. You lasted more than three hundred moves against me while I was fighting at full strength.”

[P144]
“Three hundred moves. I’m crying tears of joy.”

[P145]
“You don’t seem particularly happy, so let me put it another way. What if I told you the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun and her Elders lasted more than five hundred moves?”

[P146]
“Nope. Still not happy.”

“Why not?”

[P148]

“They died anyway.”

[P151]

[P152]
And…

[P153]
Neither was I, probably.

[P154]
“Cough.”

[P155]
Blood seeped between my parted lips.

[P156]

*Internal injuries aside, my left arm is fractured, and I think I’ve cracked some bones in my chest.*

[P158]
I’d really taken one hell of a beating. No wonder breathing had been difficult for a while now.

[P159]
Panting, I planted White Flame like a cane and dragged myself upright.

[P160]
The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes lit up.

[P161]
“Do you still have something left to show me?”

[P162]
“Of course.”

[P163]
“That must also be the power of those supernatural powers. Show me. Quickly! Quickly!”

[P164]
“I was planning to.”

[P165]
I leveled my spear at the Western Heaven Demon Lord, who was practically bouncing with excitement like a child.

[P166]

[P167]
“…?”

[P168]
“What are you waiting for? Come at me.”

[P169]
The Western Heaven Demon Lord stared at me in confusion.

[P170]
“What did you just do?”

[P171]
“I’m showing you. The supernatural powers you wanted to see.”

[P172]
“What?”

[P173]
“I’m good with my body, but hopeless with my head. I’m such a dumbass that I even failed the Level Eight Hanja exam.[^1] Then I came across the term ‘supernatural powers’ in a martial-arts novel. I didn’t know what it meant, so I looked it up.”

[P174]
He probably couldn’t understand half of what I was saying.

[P175]
My vision wavered. Every breath made my lungs prickle as though needles were stabbing into them, and the spear shaft that had always felt so light now weighed as much as a ten-thousand-geun boulder.

[P176]
Even so…

[P177]
“‘Supernatural powers.’ Mysterious beings or phenomena that can’t be explained through reason. That’s what it meant.”

[P178]
I neither staggered nor collapsed. I simply stared at the Western Heaven Demon Lord and continued slowly.

[P179]
“What’s so special about supernatural powers? A bastard who keeps fighting even after he’s been reduced to this—that’s supernatural powers.”

[P180]
Remaining Stat Points? None.

[P181]
Physical condition? It was a miracle I could still stand.

[P182]
Now that everything had flown out like the contents of Pandora’s box, the one thing left inside me wasn’t hope.

[P183]
*Sheer grit.*

[P184]
Hope could make someone rise again, but it could also make them weak.

[P185]
But as long as that grit remained—as long as I still possessed the will to fight to the bitter end—I wouldn’t fall.

[P186]
No.

[P187]
I had decided not to fall.

[P188]
Because there were people I had to protect. The Fire King and Cheongpung had fought for my sake, so even if I had to become a ghost instead of some supernatural being, I had to stop this bastard.

[P189]
“So…”

[P190]
I gathered every last scrap of internal energy. The meager handful of qi flowed unsteadily toward the spearhead.

[P191]
A faint wisp of Spear Energy lit the darkness like a firefly.

[P192]
“Quit spouting bullshit and come at me, you supernatural-powers-loving bastard.”

[P193]
The Western Heaven Demon Lord fell silent.

[P194]
Countless emotions passed across his face. When they were gone, only a pair of deeply solemn eyes remained.

[P195]
Swish!

# Mastering Adjudicator Brief

You are a **veto**, not a second novelist and not a gloss writer.

Keep SOL when it is slangier, punchier, more spoken, or more idiomatic and the Korean sense holds (`기만질` → “con me”, `톡톡히` → “full Peak Master treatment”, `득실거리다` → “crawling with”, `인간 백정` → “butcher of men”, `한 몸` → “are one”, `시원하다` in a bath → “That’s the stuff”, `어렵게 찾아오고 쉽게 깨지는 법` → “hard-won and easily broken”). ## Veto — choose `BASE`

Use `BASE` only for a real miss:

* wrong denotation, quantity, hedge, category, subject/object, or physical action

## Critical binding translation rules

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.
- Preserve every fact, causal link, joke, emotional beat, repetition, and intentional omission. Add nothing.
- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.
- Never re-romanize established names or invent grand names for uncertain terms. First use of an unlisted name or title almost always needs a footnote or a mapped ledger term.
- Use `qi` for Murim energy and `mana` for the modern Hunter system when the source distinguishes them. Preserve an established chapter-specific rendering such as `internal energy` when the exact glossary and surrounding Korean distinguish accumulated `공력` from resulting `기운`.
- In System panels, render `등급` as `**Grade:**` for quest, item, skill, and martial-art classifications. Reserve `rank` for Hunter classifications or ordinary prose; never replace a System `Grade` field with `Rank`.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.
- Keep action and injury vivid but clear rather than purple. Do not make violence funny unless the source’s framing does.
- Avoid stiff literalism, translator-added melodrama, dated internet slang, and quippy superhero-style banter.
- On the second pass, correct awkward English collocations and word choices without changing meaning or voice. Prefer ordinary, spoken English over stiff Latinate or ceremonial wording when the scene is brisk or comic: “goose bumps” rather than “gooseflesh,” and “laid into them” rather than “launched into a solemn denunciation.” Read the prose aloud and replace any phrase that sounds like a formal essay, legal document, or literal dictionary gloss unless the source deliberately calls for that register.

## Footnotes

Use `[^1]` Markdown footnotes when a brief, factual, spoiler-free explanation materially helps an English reader understand:

- a Korean institution, living arrangement, food, holiday, myth, historical reference, or local custom;
- a Korean word, phrase, idiom, wordplay, or culturally specific image that cannot be conveyed fully by the best natural English analogy;
- a deliberately literal rendering whose cultural or linguistic force would otherwise be lost.

For example, render `고시원` as “goshiwon” when the setting or connotations matter, with a concise footnote explaining that it is a very small, inexpensive room-for-rent housing arrangement. Define a term at its first meaningful occurrence and do not repeat the note unnecessarily. Footnotes must be rare, useful, and non-spoiling; do not footnote ordinary vocabulary, fully preserved jokes, or uncertainty. Record consequential uncertainty in `docs/STATE.md`.

## Spoilers and Scope

- Safe profiles contain only facts revealed through the latest completed chapter.
- Never read `characters/spoilers/` during drafting. Reviewers may consult one relevant sealed profile only for a specific unresolved continuity issue after the draft is complete.
- Future knowledge may prevent contradiction but may not add early names, pronouns, certainty, motives, or foreshadowing.
- Translate exactly one requested chapter unless the user explicitly requests a batch. Never modify Korean source files under `source/`.

The next instant, I met his unwavering gaze and realized it.

[P99]
*He read me.*

[P100]
By the time the realization flashed through my mind, it was already too late. The Sword Force that had seemed poised to cut me down abruptly changed course in midair and struck the spearhead.

[P101]
Boom!

[P102]
A roar like the sky splitting apart rang out. I clenched my teeth and held on to the spear shaft as it bucked violently in my hands.

[P103]
My ankles were already buried deep in the ground when the Sword Force swept toward me.

[P104]
Shh-shh-shh-shh-shhk!

[P105]
Above, below, left, and right.

[P106]
Terrifying energy hurtled in from thirty-six directions around me.

[P107]
Every nerve in my body screamed as I swung my spear like a madman.

[P108]
Boom! Kra-kra-kra-kaboom!

[P109]
My body staggered and my breath caught with every strike I deflected.

[P110]
This wasn’t a matter of speed or strength.

[P111]
It was martial arts—and internal energy.

[P112]
The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s martial arts occupied a distant realm beyond my reach, and the terrifying internal energy transmitted through my spear battered me from within.

[P113]
*This is fucking insane…!*

[P114]
Blood sprayed through my clenched teeth. My torn palms had long since been drenched in blood.

[P115]
I squeezed out every last ounce of strength and swung my spear at the ink-black Sword Force cleaving toward my chest.

[P116]
The second form of the Fire Dragon Divine Spear.

[P117]
*Heavenly Strike.*

[P118]
Screeeeeech! Boom!

[P119]
But unlike before, the fire dragon’s claw was pitifully weak, while the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s ink-black Sword Force hadn’t lost even a fraction of its power.

[P120]
Krrrrk!

[P121]
I was driven backward, carving a long furrow through the ground.

[P122]
Before me, the underground prison shook as though caught in an earthquake, thick clouds of dust filling the air.

[P123]
*He’s gone.*

[P124]
The Western Heaven Demon Lord was nowhere to be seen. Not ahead of me, to either side, or above.

[P125]
That left only one possibility.

[P126]
I spun around and unleashed a palm strike.

[P127]
Bang! Boom!

[P128]
Two sounds rang out at once.

[P129]
The heat of the Flame Divine Palm burned through the air, while the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s palm struck my chest.

[P130]
My vision went white. Then came the agony of my heart meridian tearing apart strand by strand. I swallowed the blood surging up my throat and regained control of my body as I was hurled backward.

[P131]
“That was remarkable. I mean it.”

[P132]
“…!”

[P133]
It was pure instinct.

[P134]
At the quiet voice that suddenly came from beside me, my arm moved on its own. The hand blade shooting toward the back of my neck struck my forearm instead.

[P135]
Crack!

[P136]
Pain flooded through me with the sound of bone shifting out of place. Then the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s foot lashed out like a whip and buried itself in my side.

[P137]
Thud! Boom!

[P138]
I smashed through the rock and became embedded in the wall. The Western Heaven Demon Lord slowly walked toward me.

[P139]
Admiration and delight filled his eyes.

[P140]
“Incredible. Truly incredible. Do you know what you just did?”

[P141]
I spat out a mouthful of bloody phlegm.

[P142]
“No, you fucking bastard.”

[P143]
“You should be proud. You lasted more than three hundred moves against me while I was fighting at full strength.”

[P144]
“Three hundred moves. I’m crying tears of joy.”

[P145]
“You don’t seem particularly happy, so let me put it another way. What if I told you the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun and her Elders lasted more than five hundred moves?”

[P146]
“Nope. Still not happy.”

[P147]
“Why not?”

[P148]
The Western Heaven Demon Lord looked genuinely baffled. I tossed him a curt answer.

[P149]
“They died anyway.”

[P150]
Three hundred moves, five hundred moves, a thousand moves—it didn’t matter. If you lost the fight, all that awaited the loser was death.

[P151]
The Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun and the Poison King had been no exception.

[P152]
And…

[P153]
Neither was I, probably.

[P154]
“Cough.”

[P155]
Blood seeped between my parted lips.

[P156]
I wanted to get up as casually as the Western Heaven Demon Lord had earlier, but my body was in no condition for that.

[P157]
*Internal injuries aside, my left arm is fractured, and I think I’ve cracked some bones in my chest.*

[P158]
I’d really taken one hell of a beating. No wonder breathing had been difficult for a while now.

[P159]
Panting, I planted White Flame like a cane and dragged myself upright.

[P160]
The Western Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes lit up.

[P161]
“Do you still have something left to show me?”

[P162]
“Of course.”

[P163]
“That must also be the power of those supernatural powers. Show me. Quickly! Quickly!”

[P164]
“I was planning to.”

[P165]
I leveled my spear at the Western Heaven Demon Lord, who was practically bouncing with excitement like a child.

[P166]
And that was all I did.

[P167]
“…?”

[P168]
“What are you waiting for? Come at me.”

[P169]
The Western Heaven Demon Lord stared at me in confusion.

[P170]
“What did you just do?”

[P171]
“I’m showing you. The supernatural powers you wanted to see.”

[P172]
“What?”

[P173]
“I’m good with my body, but hopeless with my head. I’m such a dumbass that I even failed the Level Eight Hanja exam.[^1] Then I came across the term ‘supernatural powers’ in a martial-arts novel. I didn’t know what it meant, so I looked it up.”

[P174]
He probably couldn’t understand half of what I was saying.

[P175]
My vision wavered. Every breath made my lungs prickle as though needles were stabbing into them, and the spear shaft that had always felt so light now weighed as much as a ten-thousand-geun boulder.

[P176]
Even so…

[P177]
“‘Supernatural powers.’ Mysterious beings or phenomena that can’t be explained through reason. That’s what it meant.”

[P178]
I neither staggered nor collapsed. I simply stared at the Western Heaven Demon Lord and continued slowly.

[P179]
“What’s so special about supernatural powers? A bastard who keeps fighting even after he’s been reduced to this—that’s supernatural powers.”

[P180]
Remaining Stat Points? None.

[P181]
Physical condition? It was a miracle I could still stand.

[P182]
Now that everything had flown out like the contents of Pandora’s box, the one thing left inside me wasn’t hope.

[P183]
*Sheer grit.*

[P184]
Hope could make someone rise again, but it could also make them weak.

[P185]
But as long as that grit remained—as long as I still possessed the will to fight to the bitter end—I wouldn’t fall.

[P186]
No.

[P187]
I had decided not to fall.

[P188]
Because there were people I had to protect. The Fire King and Cheongpung had fought for my sake, so even if I had to become a ghost instead of some supernatural being, I had to stop this bastard.

[P189]
“So…”

[P190]
I gathered every last scrap of internal energy. The meager handful of qi flowed unsteadily toward the spearhead.

[P191]
A faint wisp of Spear Energy lit the darkness like a firefly.

[P192]
“Quit spouting bullshit and come at me, you supernatural-powers-loving bastard.”

[P193]
The Western Heaven Demon Lord fell silent.

[P194]
Countless emotions passed across his face. When they were gone, only a pair of deeply solemn eyes remained.

[P195]
Swish!

[P196]
[^1]: Hanja are Chinese characters used in Korean writing; Level Eight is a basic certification level, making failing the exam a mark of being exceptionally bad at them.

# Mastering Adjudicator Brief

You are a **veto**, not a second novelist and not a gloss writer.

This call is isolated, non-interactive, and tool-free. The packet already contains the Korean source, both complete English versions, glossary matches, rules, and every numbered hunk. Do not call tools, search the repository, or read files. Do not announce a plan.

## Default

Choose `SOL` unless a veto below fires.

Keep SOL when it is slangier, punchier, more spoken, or more idiomatic and the Korean sense holds (`기만질` → “con me”, `톡톡히` → “full Peak Master treatment”, `득실거리다` → “crawling with”, `인간 백정` → “butcher of men”, `한 몸` → “are one”, `시원하다` in a bath → “That’s the stuff”, `어렵게 찾아오고 쉽게 깨지는 법` → “hard-won and easily broken”). **Literal closeness to Korean wording is not fidelity.** Preserve the source’s meaning and effect in natural English.

## Veto — choose `BASE`

Use `BASE` only for a real miss:

* wrong denotation, quantity, hedge, category, subject/object, or physical action
* a different English idiom than the Korean joke (`까발리다` ≠ “gives someone away”; `넉살` ≠ “banter”)

## Critical binding translation rules

# Translation Rules

## Fidelity

- Translate the Korean source—not the wiki, manhwa, fan translations, or expected plot.
- Semantic fidelity outranks elegance. Never improve rhythm, humor, or localization by changing a physical action, negation, relationship, hierarchy, mechanism, quantity, or causal detail.
- Preserve every fact, causal link, joke, emotional beat, repetition, and intentional omission. Add nothing.
- Preserve small action verbs and pragmatic cues exactly: nodding versus shaking one's head, pretending nothing happened, and mild or approachable impressions are characterization, not expendable texture.
- Preserve viewpoint and tense. Resolve omitted subjects only when context supports it; retain genuine ambiguity.
- Match each speaker's hierarchy, intimacy, humor, and profanity naturally. Do not mechanically retain every honorific or classical self-reference.
- Do not censor or soften content.

## Terminology

- `compendium.md` and `docs/NAMES.md` are binding for established names, titles, ranks, techniques, organizations, system terms, items, and locations. Profile headings and aliases join that ledger.
- Search only exact Korean terms already present in the current chapter; the compendium contains future-sensitive entries.
- Never re-romanize established names or invent grand names for uncertain terms. First use of an unlisted name or title almost always needs a footnote or a mapped ledger term.
- Use `qi` for Murim energy and `mana` for the modern Hunter system when the source distinguishes them. Preserve an established chapter-specific rendering such as `internal energy` when the exact glossary and surrounding Korean distinguish accumulated `공력` from resulting `기운`.
- In System panels, render `등급` as `**Grade:**` for quest, item, skill, and martial-art classifications. Reserve `rank` for Hunter classifications or ordinary prose; never replace a System `Grade` field with `Rank`.

## English and Markdown

- Use contemporary US English and natural action-comedy prose; avoid Korean syntax calques and generic cultivation MTL phrasing.
- File: `translations/NNNN.md`; heading: `# Chapter N`.
- Speech: curly double quotes. Direct thoughts: italics without quotes.
- Use em dashes without spaces, the ellipsis character `…`, and `* * *` for source scene breaks.
- Format each actual game System-message panel as one Markdown blockquote window headed `> **System**`. Keep all consecutive notices, fields, and lines inside that same blockquote; separate windows when prose intervenes. Do not enclose System notices or UI terms in square brackets; the `System` heading and framed blockquote identify the panel. Do not label manuals, ordinary quotations, warnings printed in a manual, or other non-System material as `System`; use a normal blockquote or a specific heading instead. Do not wrap each complete notice in outer `**`; retain bold only for meaningful labels or emphasis inside the panel.
- Keep the final file English-only reading copy: no audit notes, Korean text, summaries, or model metadata.

### Tone and Style

- Write like a polished commercial webnovel: brisk, vivid, accessible, and easy to read aloud.
- Preserve the series’ contrast between danger and comedy. Let absurdity, bad timing, blunt reactions, and grim situations create dark humor without adding jokes absent from the Korean.
- Jin Taekyung’s narration is conversational, observant, self-mocking, and occasionally profane. It may be irreverent even when the situation is serious.
- Keep deadpan punchlines short and well-timed. Do not explain a joke after delivering it.
- Preserve the source's level of explicitness. A euphemism may remain euphemistic even when its meaning is sexual or crude; do not replace it with more graphic English merely for impact.
- Make dialogue spontaneous and character-specific. Preserve hierarchy and intimacy through word choice, address, rhythm, and restraint—not archaic wuxia English.
- Use strong profanity when the Korean is strong, but neither intensify nor sanitize it. Do not make ordinary lines uniformly vulgar. Profanity should reveal mood or relationship.
- Keep action and injury vivid but clear rather than purple. Do not make violence funny unless the source’s framing does.
- Avoid stiff literalism, translator-added melodrama, dated internet slang, and quippy superhero-style banter.
- On the second pass, correct awkward English collocations and word choices without changing meaning or voice. Prefer ordinary, spoken English over stiff Latinate or ceremonial wording when the scene is brisk or comic: “goose bumps” rather than “gooseflesh,” and “laid into them” rather than “launched into a solemn denunciation.” Read the prose aloud and replace any phrase that sounds like a formal essay, legal document, or literal dictionary gloss unless the source deliberately calls for that register.

## Footnotes

Use `[^1]` Markdown footnotes when a brief, factual, spoiler-free explanation materially helps an English reader understand:

- a Korean institution, living arrangement, food, holiday, myth, historical reference, or local custom;
- a Korean word, phrase, idiom, wordplay, or culturally specific image that cannot be conveyed fully by the best natural English analogy;
- a deliberately literal rendering whose cultural or linguistic force would otherwise be lost.

For example, render `고시원` as “goshiwon” when the setting or connotations matter, with a concise footnote explaining that it is a very small, inexpensive room-for-rent housing arrangement. Prefer the best natural English analogy in the prose. Use a literal translation plus a concise footnote when the Korean wording itself matters. Define a term at its first meaningful occurrence and do not repeat the note unnecessarily. Footnotes must be rare, useful, and non-spoiling; do not footnote ordinary vocabulary, fully preserved jokes, or uncertainty. Record consequential uncertainty in `docs/STATE.md`.

## Spoilers and Scope

- Safe profiles contain only facts revealed through the latest completed chapter.
- Never read `characters/spoilers/` during drafting. Reviewers may consult one relevant sealed profile only for a specific unresolved continuity issue after the draft is complete.
- Future knowledge may prevent contradiction but may not add early names, pronouns, certainty, motives, or foreshadowing.
- Translate exactly one requested chapter unless the user explicitly requests a batch. Never modify Korean source files under `source/`.
